name: Ticket Field Extractor
description: Extracts structured fields such as order numbers and emails from support tickets. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: From each support ticket extract the customer's email address and the order id (format ORD- followed by four digits). Copy them exactly as written. Use null when a field is not in the ticket.
